tool_args.rationale: All five pilot measurements are positive and end at H=0.48, so they do not establish the predicted reversal near H=20.5. The slow-horizon probe directly tests that reversal and constrains the long-horizon response before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon measurements constrain the initial net gain but do not reliably separate the slow amplitude from its time constant for a forecast at H=20.5.
Finer time resolution does not directly test whether the slow response reverses the sign near the forecast horizon.
